div.head: Mirce 3
div.ab: Swa micel is þæs wergyldes on ……..
Swa micel is þæs wergildes on folces folcriht be Myrcna laga.
Swa micel is þæs wergyldes on folces folcriht be Myrcna laga.
Soviel ist [Betrag] dieses Wergeldes nach des Volkes gemeinem Recht im Mercier-Recht.
So much is [the amount of] this wergild by the people's common law under Mercian law.
So great is [the size of] the wergild in the common law according to the law of the Mercians;
So much is wergild in the folk law of the people, according to the law of the Mercians.
div.note: The rest of the line (‘folces folcriht be Myrcna lage’, as in D and O) was already lacking in hlq, the exemplar of H. K: ‘is’ supplied from Liebermann. Liebermann compares Norðleod 1.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘So great is [the size of] the wergild in the common law according to the law of Mercians;’).
folces . . . laga: omitted H, text supplied from D
